title: 第3823章 成功重返下界第3821章 成功仙宗长老疯狂了
lines: 在场一众仙宗长老的身体都是不由得一震。
如果许辰及时收手，根基只是受损，还有的救，可他竟然不甘心失败，放手一搏，一旦最终还是失败了，那迎接许辰的必然乃是根基尽毁。
“许辰，糊涂啊，他难道不清楚这么做的后果吗？”
现在他们已经无法干涉了，只能相信许辰，或者，听天由命了。
一众长老的心情如同过山车一般，大喜大忧。
山谷内外重新陷入一种极其诡异的寂静之中。
在这般近乎煎熬般的等待之下，时间缓缓流逝。
许辰此刻内心却是无比平静，在那丝奇特能量的帮助之下，那本已出现裂痕的根基，已然彻底修复，而且，他正在迈出最后一步。
许辰现在才知道，七塑根基有多么困难了，仅凭他个人之力，想要七塑根基成功，几乎是不可能完成的事情，不过，现在，他却有了成功的可能，而且，把握很大。
这最后一步迈的极为艰难。
当最后一点进度完成的那一瞬，许辰所有的心神仿佛都被掏空了一般，噗嗤一声，一口鲜血狂喷了出来，然后眼前一黑，直接是昏死了过去。
看着许辰忽然口喷鲜血，昏死倒地的一幕，一众仙宗高层的脸色忍不住的狠狠一变。
负责维持仙源大阵运转的石长老，脸色也是一变，顾不得维持大阵运转了，一步跨出，向着仙源大阵掠去，而有人却先他一步出现在了许辰的身旁。
看见来人，石长老并未露出丝毫的惊讶之色，他之前虽然大部分心神都投入到了仙源大阵之中，但对于仙宗之主等人的到来，还是心有所感。
石长老朝着仙宗之主喊了一句。
content_en:
Last ditch effort!
The bodies of all the elders of the Immortal Sect present could not help but tremble.
If Xu Chen had stopped in time, his foundation would only be damaged, but he could still be saved, but he was unwilling to fail and gave it a try. If he failed in the end, Xu Chen's foundation would inevitably be destroyed.
"Xu Chen, you're confused. Doesn't he know the consequences of doing this?"
An elder shook his head and sighed.
Now they can no longer interfere and can only trust Xu Chen or resign themselves to fate.
The mood of all the elders was like a roller coaster, filled with joy and sorrow.
soon.
Everyone shut their mouths.
The valley fell into an extremely strange silence again.
Under such an almost torturous wait, time passed slowly.
Xu Chen felt extremely calm at the moment. With the help of that strange energy, the cracked foundation had been completely repaired, and he was taking the final step.
The last step is extremely difficult.
Only now did Xu Chen realize how difficult it was to build the Seven-Shape Foundation. It was almost impossible to achieve the Seven-Shape Foundation with his own strength alone. However, now, he had the possibility of success, and he was very sure of it.
Soon!
Soon!
Ninety-one percent.
Ninety-two percent.
Ninety-three percent.
…
…
Time passes slowly.
This last step was extremely difficult.
Ninety-nine percent!
Not even close.
Just the last bit!
Xu Chen roared in his heart.
"Boom!!!!"
When the last bit of progress was completed, Xu Chen seemed to have been drained of all his energy. With a puff, a mouthful of blood spurted out, and then his vision went black and he passed out.
Seeing Xu Chen suddenly spitting blood and falling to the ground unconscious, the faces of the senior officials of the Immortal Sect couldn't help but change severely.
"Oops!"
"Xu Chen passed out!"
"Failed?"
"Success or failure?"
"..."
Elder Shi, who was responsible for maintaining the operation of the Immortal Source Formation, also changed his expression. He no longer cared about maintaining the operation of the Immortal Source Formation. He took a step forward and rushed towards the Immortal Source Formation. However, someone appeared beside Xu Chen one step ahead of him.
Seeing the person coming, Elder Shi did not show the slightest surprise. Although he had focused most of his attention on the Immortal Source Formation before, he was still feeling the arrival of the Lord of the Immortal Sect and others.
"Sect Master!"
Elder Shi shouted towards the Lord of the Immortal Sect.
title_en: Chapter 3823: Successful return to the lower world Chapter 3821: The elder of the Successful Immortal Sect is crazy
